description:
NEW FILE: apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/extension/behaviour.ex

Define the OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Behaviour module with:

1. @optional_callback mount() :: {:ok, term()} -- if exported, signals stateful extension; called once during init/1 to get initial state.

2. For EACH event type returned by Event.event_types/0, define TWO optional callbacks:
   - 2-arity (stateless): handle_<event_type>(event :: Event.t(), ctx :: Context.t()) :: term()
   - 3-arity (stateful):  handle_<event_type>(event :: Event.t(), ctx :: Context.t(), state :: term()) :: {term(), term()}
   Use @optional_callbacks for all of them.

3. The naming convention: event type atom :turn_start -> handle_turn_start, :before_tool_call -> handle_before_tool_call, etc.

NO existing files change. This is a new module only.

TEST: New test file behaviour_test.exs. Verify that a module using @behaviour OctoPi.Coder.Extension.Behaviour compiles without warnings when implementing only a subset of callbacks. Verify that a module implementing handle_turn_start/2 and handle_turn_start/3 both compile (the two-arity convention must allow both).
title: Define Extension.Behaviour
